fusions.name: Heaped Mouthful
fusions.desc: Scoops a bite out of the target with the blade's edge, dealing 4 damage, leaving it 6% easier to wound for 3 seconds, and healing you for 30% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Pit Roast
fusions.desc: Uncovers a pit oven under your feet, dealing 26 fire damage that ignores resistances to every enemy within 3 tiles. You heal for 30% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Root Harvest
fusions.desc: Digs up a crop and shares it. It restores 14 health to you and every ally within 4 tiles, more the faster you cast.

fusions.name: Fed Labourer
fusions.desc: Whenever you are healed, your physical damage rises by 20% for 4 seconds. Once every 6 seconds.
